description: This file defines a React hook `useLinksService` that provides CRUD operations and analytics for managing links within a React application. It interacts with a Supabase backend and optionally an Express API, handling authentication, filtering, sorting, and click tracking for link data.

methods.name: useLinksService()
methods.description: Main hook providing operations for link management, including list, create, update, delete, increment clicks, and retrieve analytics.

methods.name: waitForSession(timeoutMs = 5000)
methods.description: Waits for the authentication session to load, with optional timeout.

methods.name: getAuthHeaders()
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization headers with the current user's access token.

methods.name: qs(params)
methods.description: Constructs URL query string from parameters.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Fetches a list of links for the current user with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new link record for the current user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing link owned by the current user.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a link owned by the current user.

methods.name: incrementClicks
methods.description: Increments the click count for a specific link, with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: analytics
methods.description: Retrieves aggregate analytics data for current user's links.
